title: Anthropic Seals $35 Billion Cloud Deal With Nvidia-Backed Lambda
description: Anthropic PBC agreed to a $35 billion computing deal with Lambda, a cloud provider backed by Nvidia Corp., part of an effort to quickly expand its AI capacity, according to a person familiar with the matter.

title: Airbnb Rolls Out Pilot Program in US to Lower Fees Paid by Hosts to 6% or 10%
description: Airbnb Inc. is testing taking a smaller cut of rental fees from hosts, seeking to fight back against a trend of customers booking directly outside of its platform.

title: Asia Data Center Debt Binge Hitting Banks’ Limits, Barclays Says
description: The billions of dollars being borrowed to fund data centers in Asia are pushing banks to their limits and making them more selective about which projects to finance, according to senior bankers at Barclays Plc.
